critical_errors.location: pi_dddabcb5edbe492cf0dc8342, final proof, “The node over −∞”, definition of I_n and the asserted clamp-image containment
critical_errors.issue: The construction does not restrict the starting index to ensure that −n lies in the original finite tail. Consequently, the assertion κ_n([−∞,r′)) ⊆ I_n=[−n,r′+2δ] can fail, and T_n and G_n need not be defined. For example, the permitted choices r=−2, r′=−3 and δ=1/8 give I_1=[−1,−11/4], which is empty, while κ_1(−∞)=−1 also lies outside the original domain q<−2.

gaps.location: pi_dddabcb5edbe492cf0dc8342, final proof, “The remaining strata over −∞”, full star endpoint case
gaps.issue: The assertion that V_n(t,q)=max{u(t,q),u(t_0,q)−n} is finite omits the identically −∞ finite-stratum case. Such a germ satisfies the comparison conditions, but its proposed V_n remains identically −∞, so the finite continuous uniform-regularization argument does not apply. The earlier case split concerns node germs and does not cover an arbitrary full-endpoint germ.

At a full star endpoint, first apply the extended-real convexity dichotomy: handle an identically −∞ finite stratum using the exact traces and constant approximants −n, and use the truncation and uniform smoothing construction only in the finite-stratum case.
